descriptions.notStarted: I better go see Black Mesoranger, who should be somewhere around Kulan Field.
descriptions.inProgress: At a field around Omega Sector, I met this strangely-dressed man who called himself Black Mesoranger. He requested that I eliminate the alien that's been taking over Kulan Field, the #bBarnard Gray#k, 25 of them to be exact.\n\n#o4230116# #r#a34121#
descriptions.completed: I successfully completed the mission from Black Mesoranger by defeating the #bBarnard Grays#k. It seems, however, that there will be much more dangerous aliens monsters around Kulan Field
